faq.question: Q1. What is the RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi University has invited candidates for a walk-in interview to engage Teaching Assistants for Geography and English under the Department of Education.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available, including 2 for Geography and 1 for English.

faq.question: Q3. When is the RGU Teaching Assistant walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 09 October 2026 at 10:30 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the RGU Teaching Assistant interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at the Chamber of Head, Department of Education, RGU.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Geography?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc in Geography with minimum 55% marks, a B.Ed. Degree with minimum 55% marks, and must have cleared NET/SLET/SET or hold a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for English?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MA in English with minimum 55% marks, a B.Ed. Degree with minimum 55% marks, and must have cleared NET/SLET/SET or hold a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for RGU Teaching Assistants?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1000/- per class up to a maximum of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the engagement?
faq.answer: The post is purely temporary for a period of 1 (one) semester, which may be extendable if needed by the University.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be provided for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
